entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: A massively destructive artifact created by the Thran or an earlier civilization, used by Urza to unleash the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer who activates the Sylex at Argoth with his blood and grief, igniting his spark.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, who refused the Sylex.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: An artificer who made a counterfeit sylex, captured Loran and passed the real Sylex to Tawnos.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's apprentice who conveyed the Sylex and its detonation process to Urza.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: A woman who fled Terisia City with the Sylex to keep it from the brothers, and was captured by Ashnod.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: A scholar in Terisia City who studied the Sylex and translated its glyphs.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A planeswalker who obtained a Sylex and threatened the Sages of Minorad with it.

entities.name: Ash Warlord Embereck
entities.description: A figure Ravidel dueled for the Sylex in a sunken city of Terisiare.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: A character who used the long-daggers to make the Sylex vulnerable to a shatter spell.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Jared find the long-daggers.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem who dug up the Sylex in Yavimaya to destroy New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An artificer in whose closet on the Mana Rig Karn hid the Sylex.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Leader of the Phyrexian sleeper agents focused on Karn's plan.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who, compleated, crumpled the Sylex and took Karn to New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer planeswalker who made a perfect replica of the Sylex.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A figure who traveled back in time with Saheeli's Temporal Anchor to learn the Sylex's activation.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who took the duplicate Sylex to New Phyrexia and tried to stop Jace.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who attacked Jace to interrupt the blast.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A compleating mind mage who insists on detonating the replica Sylex.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who impales Jace and seizes the Sylex.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon whose love Jace pours into the Sylex.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A Phyrexian device at New Phyrexia's Seedcore that connects planes through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane Karn and later the planeswalkers sought to destroy.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The explosion that destroyed Argoth and both armies and began the Ice Age.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The island destroyed by the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war that the Sylex Blast ended.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: A cult that craved the real Sylex and was fooled by Ashnod's counterfeit.

events.summary: Yumok fishermen accidentally net the Sylex in 36 AR and send it to Feldon in Terisia City.
events.quote: The Sylex was accidentally netted by Yumok fishermen in 36 AR , and sent to Feldon in Terisia City for study.

events.summary: Ashnod makes a counterfeit sylex as a decoy that fools the Brotherhood of Gix.
events.quote: This cylix was used to fool the Brotherhood of Gix

events.summary: Loran flees Terisia City with the Sylex, but is later wounded, captured and relieved of it by Ashnod.
events.quote: She was later wounded, captured, and relieved of the sylex by Ashnod .

events.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos, who conveys it and its detonation process to Urza.
events.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it and its detonation process to Urza.

events.summary: In remorse, Urza performs the Sylex's ritual with his blood, grief and pain and activates it.
events.quote: He spoke the words of the inscription, and the sylex activated.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth, begins the Ice Age and ignites Urza's spark.
events.quote: Caught at the epicenter of the blast, Urza's spark ignited.

events.summary: Ravidel obtains a Sylex after a duel and threatens the Sages of Minorad, extracting a promise not to interfere.
events.quote: Ravidel appeared at Minorad and threatened to use the Sylex

events.summary: Jared Carthalion uses the long-daggers to make that Sylex vulnerable to a shatter spell, which destroys it.
events.quote: Jared used the daggers to make it vulnerable to a shatter spell, which finally destroyed the artifact.

events.summary: Karn digs up the Sylex in Yavimaya, planning to use it against New Phyrexia, then hides it in Jhoira's closet on the Mana Rig.
events.quote: Karn dug up the Sylex in Yavimaya , planning to use it to destroy New Phyrexia .

events.summary: During the assault on the Thran Mana Rig, the compleated Ajani crumples the Sylex and takes a disabled Karn to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: the compleated Ajani crumpled the Sylex and took a disabled Karn to New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Saheeli Rai makes a perfect replica of the Sylex, and Teferi travels back in time to learn how it is activated.
events.quote: Saheeli Rai , another artificer planeswalker, made a perfect replica using the plans Karn had uncovered.

events.summary: Teferi learns from Urza's spirit that the trigger was a person of a certain desperate mindset, not a spell.
events.quote: The trigger to detonate the Sylex was not a spell or an artifact — it was a person

events.summary: Kaya lets Jace telepathically extract the activation method and travels with other planeswalkers to New Phyrexia with the duplicate Sylex.
events.quote: she allowed Jace Beleren to telepathically extract this information from her.

events.summary: At the Seedcore Jace, compleating, insists on detonating the Sylex despite Kaya's warnings, evades Kaya and Kaito, and completes the ritual.
events.quote: He ran his thumbnail across his forehead, dripping the ichor from the wound into the bowl.

events.summary: Elspeth bursts in, impales Jace with her halo-infused blade, seizes the Sylex and planeswalks away.
events.quote: burst into the chamber, impaled Jace with her halo-infused blade, and seized the Sylex, planeswalking away.

relations.note: Ashnod captured Loran and took the Sylex.
relations.quote: She was later wounded, captured, and relieved of the sylex by Ashnod .

relations.note: He conveyed the Sylex to Urza.
relations.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it and its detonation process to Urza.

relations.note: Elspeth impales Jace to stop him.
relations.quote: impaled Jace with her halo-infused blade
Saheeli Rai , another artificer planeswalker, made a perfect replica using the plans Karn had uncovered.

relations.note: She made a counterfeit sylex as a decoy.
relations.quote: Ashnod made a counterfeit sylex as a decoy, through simple metalworking
